children: Italy food producer's half-year revenue exceeded EUR 3 bln, up sharply from prior year
Half-year consol EBITDA rose 64% yr/yr, reflecting improved margins and operational efficiency
Company posted net loss of EUR 5.8 mln, as selling prices declined but volumes stable
NewPrinces expects FY 2026 EBITDA to reach €330–350 mln
Company sees improved margins driven by lower raw material costs and operational efficiency
Company expects sales volumes to remain broadly stable in current market conditions
ACQUISITIONS - Revenue growth driven by contributions from acquisitions completed in late 2025
LOWER RAW MATERIAL COSTS - Margins improved due to double-digit reductions in costs of milk and durum wheat, passed on to customers
VOLUME STABILITY - Sales volumes remained broadly stable across segments despite price adjustments
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "strong buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 2 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the food processing peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for NewPrinces SpA is €25.55, about 50.4% above its September 14 closing price of €16.99
